visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Password stays visible
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After the first tap the password is shown, but a second tap never hides it again, so the button only works once.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
<input id="pw" type="password" value="abc123">
<button id="eye">Show</button>
<script>
  var pw = document.getElementById('pw');
  document.getElementById('eye').addEventListener('click', function () {
    pw.type = 'text';
  });
</script>

solution.code:
<input id="pw" type="password" value="abc123">
<button id="eye">Show</button>
<script>
  var pw = document.getElementById('pw');
  document.getElementById('eye').addEventListener('click', function () {
    pw.type = pw.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
  });
</script>
solution.explanation: The handler always sets the type to text, so it can never go back. A toggle has to look at the current state and set the other one.
